content.text: 2026-07-03 (Friday) is a business day on the Federal Reserve banking calendar. Reason: Open. Independence Day falls on Saturday 2026-07-04; Federal Reserve Banks stay open the Friday before, although federal (OPM) employees are off today. Previous business day 2026-07-02, next 2026-07-06.
